The upload size limit is 1,048,576 bytes per file … refused for size and creates zero users. … The import record limit is 1,000 user records per file … refused for record count and creates zero users.
Submitting a zero-byte file or a recognized header with no data records creates zero users and reports that the file contains no users. … A valid CSV containing one new user creates one user.

verdicts.missing: The specification does not say whether notices from a bulk import go out together or at a limited rate, or what that rate would be.

verdicts.missing: A builder must look up the host policy to determine whether the account starts active or pending, whether it has a password, and what the first sign-in requires.

verdicts.quote: Raw file bytes and filenames are absent from live import storage after the attempt reaches an outcome or a ready attempt expires. … It does not return the raw file
verdicts.missing: Live retention and result access are specified. The storage location during processing and the duration of any backup copies are unspecified.

verdicts.quote: If the directory already exposes an audit record for creating a user, a committed imported user is visible through its ordinary user-creation audit activity under the same access rules.
verdicts.missing: No required audit fields link an import's administrator, affected users, and time in a single traceable event or set of records.

verdicts.quote: An accepted attempt offers no cancellation control. … an administrator can correct and resubmit a whole file without tracking partial creation … After a refusal, an administrator can open a new attempt to submit a corrected file.
